title: Handle a bad age
objective: Write a function that can fail for a bad input, handle the failure with attempt, and fix a wrong condition.

body.text: A function that can fail must be called with attempt. Check the bad input first, and use fail with to give the reason. Then the caller can print the reason or the answer. Read the condition carefully: a check that is backwards fails on the good input.

body.title: Years to months
body.code:
function months
    takes number called years
    returns a number
    can fail
    if years is less than 0
        fail with "negative age"
    gives back years times 12

attempt months 2 if it fails then
    say problem
otherwise
    say result

attempt months -1 if it fails then
    say problem
otherwise
    say result

body.prompt: The check is backwards, so a good age of 2 fails. Fix the condition so the program prints 24.
